member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Content.ProsperoElfHeader
member.summary: Reader and in-place editor for the 64-bit ELF header (the first 0x40 bytes of an ELF file).
member.remarks:
Field layout (little-endian scalars):
e_ident at 0x00, 16 bytes: magic 7F 45 4C 46, class (0x04), data (0x05), header version (0x06), OS/ABI (0x07), ABI version (0x08), then padding.
e_type (0x10, u16), e_machine (0x12, u16), e_version (0x14, u32).
e_entry (0x18, u64), e_phoff (0x20, u64), e_shoff (0x28, u64).
e_flags (0x30, u32), e_ehsize (0x34, u16), e_phentsize (0x36, u16), e_phnum (0x38, u16), e_shentsize (0x3A, u16), e_shnum (0x3C, u16), e_shstrndx (0x3E, u16).
The editing methods change only the header bytes they name; program headers, section headers and segment data are left untouched.

member.summary: Normalizes the ELF header before building (machine to x86-64, a System V / GNU OS/ABI to FreeBSD, a placeholder type to executable) so a plain homebrew ELF is accepted as a module. A module whose header is already correct is left unchanged. Defaults to .

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Content.ProsperoFself
member.summary: Reader and producer for the SELF container used by PS5 executable modules.
member.remarks:
Layout (little-endian scalars):
Container header, 0x20 bytes: magic 0x1D3D154F, version/mode/endian/attr bytes, program type, header size, metadata size, file size, segment count, flags.
Segment table at 0x20, one 0x20-byte entry per segment: flags, file offset, file size, memory size. Content segments come in pairs (a zero-filled digest segment then the data segment).
ELF header and program headers, copied verbatim.
Extended info (0x40) after the program headers: authority id, program type, versions, and the SHA-256 of the input ELF.
A zero-filled metadata footer, then the plaintext segment data.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Content.ProsperoSelfAuthInfo
member.summary: A parsed SELF authentication-info sidecar (*.auth_info), a fixed 0x88-byte record.
member.remarks:
Layout (little-endian scalars):
0x00program authority id (paid), 8 bytes.
0x08capability words, four 64-bit values (0x20 bytes).
0x28attribute words, four 64-bit values (0x20 bytes).
0x48reserved tail, 0x40 bytes.
The record is structural: the capability and attribute words are grants issued for the original module and are copied verbatim when a sidecar is carried alongside a module. This type never synthesizes a grant; takes whatever material the caller supplies.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Content.ProsperoUcp
member.summary: Reader and producer for the UCP archive format used by the trophy and user-data-system components of a PS5 package.
member.remarks:
Layout (big-endian scalars):
Header, 0x60 bytes: 0x00 u32 magic 0xB228C60A; 0x04 u32 version (1); 0x08 u64 total file size; 0x10 u32 entry count; 0x14 u32 entry-record size (0x40); 0x18 u32 zero; 0x1C 20-byte SHA-1 digest; 0x30..0x60 reserved zero.
Entry table at 0x60, one 0x40-byte record per entry: 32-byte name (NUL-padded), u64 offset, u64 size, 16 reserved bytes.
Blob region: entries in ascending name order, each blob followed by padding to the next 16-byte boundary (a full 16 bytes when the end is already aligned); the file size is padded the same way. The digest covers the whole file with the digest field held zero.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.KrakenDecoder
member.summary: A complete managed Kraken (newLZ) chunk decoder. Decodes one PFS block (one or two internal newLZ chunks) into a caller-supplied destination buffer. This is the production decoder used by to read both this library's own output and compatible encoded blocks.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.KrakenDecoder.DecodeBlock(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Span{System.Byte})
member.summary: Decodes a whole PFS block (the section-7 payload) into (sized to the block's exact uncompressed length). is the block's on-disk boundary flag byte; is the first sub-chunk's compressed size (from the boundary size hint) and is only consulted when the block spans two sub-chunks (its uncompressed size exceeds one 128 KiB chunk). A two-chunk block's sub-chunks have INDEPENDENT types — each is newLZ or a bare-entropy Kraken_DecodeBytes array selected by (chunk0: bit 0x02; chunk1: bit 0x20) — so they are decoded separately, the second seedless and able to back-reference the first. The literal model for each newLZ sub-chunk comes from its low bit (chunk0 0x01, chunk1 0x10): set = sub/delta, clear = raw.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.KrakenDecoder.DecodeBareEntropyBlock(System.Byte[],System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Byte[],System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Decodes one bare-entropy array: bytes at are a single Kraken_DecodeBytes array (raw type-0 or Huffman type-2/4) that expands to exactly bytes written at in — no seed, no excess framing, no LZ table, no back-references. A block larger than one 128 KiB chunk is encoded as two such arrays back-to-back (each independent). The array must consume its whole source span.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.OodleKrakenEncoder
member.summary:
Managed Kraken (newLZ) encoder. Compresses a PFS block into one or two headerless newLZ "excess mode" chunks that round-trip through the PS5 block decompressor.
Length escapes. A literal run longer than 257 bytes (packed value litLen-3 >= 255) and a match longer than (packed value matchLen-17 >= 255) are carried by a 0xFF packed_litlen marker plus a u32 escape value. Every escape in a chunk is collected in packed_litlen order and written into a trailing excess sub-stream, split even index -> forward writer / odd index -> backward writer and laid out forward ++ reverse(backward), mirroring the paired readers the decoder uses. The post-seed control byte is 0x80 | low6(excessByteCount) with a continuation byte when the count exceeds 0x1F. Over-long matches are split into <= pieces so in practice only literal runs escape; a chunk needing more than escapes falls back to the stored path.
No match may start in the last (16) bytes of a chunk. The newLZ release parse loop enforces match_zone_end - to_ptr >= lrl where match_zone_end = chunk_end - 16: the literal-run end (= match start) must be <= chunk_end - 16. A match that starts later drifts the decode pointer and the block is rejected with error -1007. The parser therefore stops emitting matches past chunkEnd - NoMatchZone and flushes the remainder as the trailing literal run; a store-raw safety net rejects any chunk that would still violate it.
Returns null when compression is not worthwhile (caller stores the block).

The packed-offset array is always left raw because the offset reader inspects its first byte (the 0x80 bit selects two-table mode), which an entropy header would corrupt.

member.name: P:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.PfsBlock.IsBareEntropy
member.summary: true when a compressed block is a single bare-entropy array rather than an LZ stream (boundary flag bit 0x02 clear). The whole block payload is then one Kraken entropy array (typically a type-2 Huffman array) that expands directly to the uncompressed bytes — no seed, no LZ table, no literal model. The encoder emits this form when entropy coding helps but LZ matching does not (skewed-frequency data). Always false for stored and newLZ blocks.

member.name: P:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.PfsBlock.LiteralMode
member.summary: The newLZ literal model for this compressed block, recovered from the boundary flag's low bit (the bit the PFS layer feeds into the reconstructed Oodle chunk header): 1 = raw literals, 0 = sub/delta literals. Irrelevant for stored blocks.

member.name: P:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.PfsBlock.Flags
member.summary: The raw boundary-table flag byte for this block (bits 48..55 of the id=3 entry). This is the authoritative per-sub-chunk type/literal-model selector consumed by : chunk0 newLZ = bit 0x02 (literal model bit 0x01); chunk1 newLZ = bit 0x20 (literal model bit 0x10), bare-entropy chunk1 = bit 0x40. member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoOuterPfsImage
member.summary: AES-XTS encrypt/decrypt for the PS5 nwonly outer finalized-image PFS. Each whole filesystem block is one XTS data unit numbered by its image block index; the metadata (superblock) block is left plaintext. See the file header for how this differs from the inner-image crypto in and how it was validated.

member.name: F:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoOuterPfsImage.DefaultBlockSize
member.summary: The outer finalized-image PFS block size (one block = one AES-XTS data unit).

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoOuterPfsImage.Transform(System.Span{System.Byte},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.Int32,System.ReadOnlySpan{LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoOuterBlockKind},System.Boolean)
member.summary: AES-XTS transforms in place using an explicit per-block classification: blocks use sector = block index, blocks use sector = | block index (PS5), and blocks are left untouched. This is the full validated outer-image scheme (data blocks 0-4 plain, superblock (block 6) plaintext, signed blocks 5,7-10 with bit 47 set). Returns the number of blocks transformed.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsBuilder
member.summary: Contains the functionality to construct a PFS disk image.

member.name: F:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsBuilder.CaptureImageDigests
member.summary: When set before , captures the sce_sys/imagedigs.dat preimage into : one per-block descriptor digest for every block of the plaintext signed image, stored from last byte to first. Each per-block HMAC-SHA256 descriptor digest, from this image's own signing key, is stored with its bytes reversed (byte 31 first). Populated only for a signed image.

member.name: F:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsBuilder.ImageDigests
member.summary: The captured imagedigs.dat body (N * 32 bytes for N image blocks), or null until a signed image is written with set. See that property.

member.name: F:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsBuilder.CaptureSuperblockIcv
member.summary: When set before , captures this image's superblock integrity value into : the 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 self-signature of the superblock (final signature block 0 @ offset 0x380), computed from this image's own signing key during signing (before XTS encryption). Used for the supplemental pfsimage.xml <icv> element. Populated only for a signed image.

member.name: F:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsBuilder.SuperblockIcv
member.summary: The captured 32-byte superblock ICV (see ), or null until a signed image is written with that flag set.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsImage.VerifyRoundTrip(System.String,LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPfsImageOptions)
member.summary: Proves the encrypt/decrypt pair is loss-less for a given image without leaving any artefacts: encrypts a temporary copy, decrypts it back and compares the filesystem data (every sector after the plaintext header block) to the original exactly. member.param: Backing memory reader over the PFS image.
Superblock pfs_flags selecting the crypto scheme (e.g. the newCrypt bit).
Image key used to derive the per-image XTS keys, or null for a plaintext image.
Explicit XTS tweak key, or null to derive it from .
Explicit XTS data key, or null to derive it from .

Byte offset of the superblock within the image. 0 for a normal superblock-first PFS; for a PS5 "data-first" outer PFS the superblock sits near the end (block D), so the caller passes D*blockSize. Block pointers stay absolute from the image base (offset 0); only the superblock and the dinode table (block D+1) are located relative to this offset.

When true, the image is already plaintext (e.g. a data-first outer PFS the caller decrypted up-front with the per-block plain/signed XTS scheme), so the reader must NOT re-apply its linear XTS even though the superblock's mode still carries the Encrypted flag.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPs5InnerImageAssembler.BuildBlockInfoTable(System.Int64)
member.summary:
Builds the 32-byte inner block-75 table (the PFSv3 inner block-info table that precedes the compressed metadata block). Each 8-byte entry is { u32 value, u32 version } (little-endian): three template entries carry ; the fourth carries a value derived structurally from the uroot content.
The variable entry, read big-endian (b0·2^16 + b1·2^8 + b2), equals 0x27373C − 4·(Σ(uroot file sizes) mod 0x40000). It encodes the sub-256KiB remainder of the total uroot payload size. sce_sys module files and the inner metadata tables are not files in the afid list, so they are naturally excluded from the sum. The stored little-endian value is that big-endian result with bytes stored in b2,b1,b0 order; a single global constant is used, with no per-package discriminator.
member.param: Sum of the uncompressed sizes of the uroot (non-sce_sys) inner files.

member.summary: Builds the 0x10000-byte finalized-image (FIH) header block. This is a SHARED, cycle-free helper used by both the standalone FIH writer () and the PS5 CNT builder so the fixed-info-digest (SHA3-256 of this block) is self-consistent. The image-content slot 0xB0 is the nested-image-content digest: when is supplied (the CNT build path, which has the uncompressed inner image in hand) it is written verbatim as SHA3-256 of the UNCOMPRESSED inner PFS image at its plain size; when it is null (the standalone finalize path, which only has the finished encrypted CNT) it falls back to the best-effort SHA3-256(outer image). Cycle-free either way: both inputs are final before the CNT digest table is computed (using the embedded CNT metadata here would create a digest cycle).

member.summary: Section map with an EXPLICIT fidx (UncompressedOffsetStartByFileIdx) entry count. The fidx count is NOT a fixed function of — it also carries per-padding/metadata pseudo-entries emitted by the compressor's addData/flush, so it varies per package (DebugSettings = 9, Downloads = 7). Callers that know the real count (parse: derived from the blob length; build: the document's FileOffsets count) pass it here; the fixed-count overload keeps the legacy NumFiles+1 default.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoNapsLayout.DeriveFidxEntryCount(LibProsperoPkg.PKG.NapsLayoutCounts,System.Int64)

CblockInfo is the last section (no trailer), so its start = blobLength − NumCblockInfo·9; the fidx count is what remains after the fixed header/outer-block/shuffle/u2c sections. Returns NumFiles+1 as a fallback when the blob is padded or the arithmetic is not exact.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoNapsLayoutBuilder
member.summary: Generator for the PS5 naps_pkg_layout.dat CblockInfo/u2c/fidx sections. Walks a per-block compression plan with a compressed-offset cursor and emits a that serializes from modeled fields.

list.item: A RUN-base record re-bases the compressed cursor: coffEnd = cursor mod 0x40000 (captured before the reset), CoffsetStart256K = 2*floor(onDisk/0x40000), TweakIdxStart = onDisk >> 15 (0 for the terminator), then the cursor resets to absC = 2*onDisk - (onDisk mod 0x40000).

A STD record: CoffsetStartMod256K = cursor mod 0x40000, UoffsetStart = (2*(logical mod 0x40000)) & 0x3FFFF, ClenEvenMinus1 = min(2*(evenComp-1), 0x1FFFE), plus the even/odd/kde/shuf flags. The cursor then advances by the block's stream length.
The terminator STD is a sentinel: UoffsetStart = 1, ClenEvenMinus1 = 1, all flags 0.

u2c packs a per-ublock "first CblockInfo index" table I[u] = the index of the first STD whose logical start >= u*0x40000 (missing ublocks point at the terminator index), in a phase-shifted 8-block grouping.

member.summary: Builds the encrypted naps_meta_18.dat metric blob for a finalized image. The plaintext TLV carries the inner-image geometry (phdr), the content-file table (file/fstr), the per-block info tables (ibcl/i2ob/i2op/ihsh/rhsh) with real block digests over , the outer digest (obdg), a fixed marker (twek) and the four 48-byte descriptor records (pgpl/pgil/pgpi/pgpu). The stream is padded to a 16-byte multiple and AES-128-XTS encrypted.
member.param: Block-aligned inner-image size (finalized-image header offset 0xA0).
The finalized FIH+PFS+CNT mount image; block digests are computed over it.
Inner content files in load order: relative path and plain size.

The assembled nwonly inner-image result. When supplied, the per-block info tables (ibcl/i2ob/i2op/ihsh) and the file record describe the compressed inner-image NAPS block map (afid raw extents + data-region hole ublocks + metadata ublocks) instead of an identity map over the outer . When (legacy inners), the exact previous outer-block behavior is kept. obdg/rhsh stay over the outer image in both cases.
member.returns: The encrypted blob (length a multiple of 16), or an empty array when inputs are insufficient.

member.summary: Opens a PS5 nwonly "data-first" outer PFS: the plaintext superblock is at (block D near the end of the image), file data occupies the leading blocks, and the AES-XTS scheme is per-block — pfs_image.dat data blocks use sector = block index, every other file/metadata block uses sector = bit47 | index, and the superblock is plaintext (see ). member.summary: CNT-build overload that also surfaces the FIH 0xB0 nested-image-content digest — SHA3-256 of the UNCOMPRESSED inner PFS image. The plaintext inner image exists only during this build pass, so the digest is threaded out here for the caller that finalizes the CNT into a debug (FIH) image (), which would otherwise only have the encrypted CNT and fall back to a best-effort outer-image hash. Also surfaces the reproducible so the finalizer can assemble the trailing debug SI segment (sce_suppl) from the finalized mount image.

member.summary: Builds the reproducible for the trailing debug SI segment from the finalized CNT () and outer image (). Every value maps to something the builder already produced — the general digests, the header/body/ fixed-info digests, the container geometry and the CNT entry table — so the emitted pfsimage.xml is self-consistent with the produced package.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoPkgSigner.EncryptHeaderDigest(System.Byte[])
member.summary: Produces the 384-byte CNT header-signature value: the 32-byte SHA3-256 header digest is PKCS#1 v1.5 (type 2) padded and raised to the public exponent of the PKG-metadata RSA-3072 key. member.param: The 32-byte SHA3-256 digest of the CNT header region.
member.exception: The PKG-metadata key is unavailable.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoSiArchive.BuildDebugSiSegment(LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoPfsImageXmlOptions,System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Int64,System.Collections.Generic.ICollection{System.String})
member.summary:
Builds the complete debug SI segment (the trailing sce_suppl ZIP) for a finalized nwonly image entirely from values the package build has already produced. This is the high-level entry point the package builder wires into through its siArchiveFactory: given the reproducible options and the finalized (FIH + PFS + CNT) it derives every reproducible member and returns the raw ZIP bytes.
common/etc/pfsimage.xml from (real self-consistent digests, entries and geometry).
common/etc/naps_meta_300/301/302/308.dat derived from the finalized-image inner-image size at FIH offset via .
common/etc/playgo-chunk.dat copied verbatim from (the CNT's PlayGo chunk descriptor) when present.
config/<content-id>/playgo-chunk.crc computed by CRC-32C over the finalized mount image.
The naps_meta_18.dat metric blob is built by from the finalized image and its content-file set (AES-128-XTS TLV) when the inner-image size is known.
member.param: Fully-populated reproducible pfsimage.xml options from the builder.
CNT PlayGo chunk descriptor bytes (entry 0x1001), or null.
The finalized FIH+PFS+CNT mount image.

Block-aligned stored size of the inner pfs_image.dat (the FIH-0xA0 value), captured by the builder. When positive it drives the naps_meta_300 record directly. When 0 (e.g. a standalone caller with only the finalized image) it falls back to reading FIH[0xA0] out of , which is only populated for the data-first layout.
Optional sink for any all-zero-placeholder notices from the XML builder.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PlayGo.ProsperoPlayGo.BuildChunkCrc(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte})
member.summary: Builds the PS5 sce_suppl/config/<content-id>/playgo-chunk.crc by reducing the finalized mount image with CRC-32C (Castagnoli) in 64KiB blocks and serialising each block's checksum as a little-endian uint32, in block order. The is the FIH+PFS+SC region that precedes the SI segment (i.e. everything from offset 0 up to the SI archive); a finalized mount image is always a whole number of 64KiB blocks, but a trailing partial block (if any) is reduced over its actual length.
member.param: The finalized mount image bytes (FIH header + PFS image + embedded CNT).
member.returns: The playgo-chunk.crc payload: 4 bytes per 64KiB block.

member.summary: Builds the PS5 sce_sys/playgo-ficm.dat. The file is a 16-byte header followed by a -byte per-file array (zero-filled), so its total length is 16 + fileCount.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PlayGo.ProsperoPlayGo.BuildHashTable(System.UInt32)
member.summary: Builds the PS5 sce_sys/playgo-hash-table.dat (CNT entry id 0x2010). The file is a 0x28-byte header, a 16-byte constant prefix, then a -entry constant table (8 bytes each), so its total length is 0x38 + chunkCount * 8. The number of hash-table chunks is half the PlayGo file/inode count stamped in playgo-ficm.dat (ficm 8 -> 4 chunks, ficm 10 -> 5 chunks).
member.param: The hash-table chunk count (= ficmFileCount / 2).

member.summary: Produces the final PS5 package via . The output is a complete \x7FCNT package with the inner + AES-XTS-encrypted outer PFS, all entries, every metadata digest and the header signature. The result is checked in-process with the reader and an outer-PFS decrypt round-trip; the detached metadata signature pass then exercises the wired-in publishing key material too. On-console acceptance depends on console mode and firmware.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.ProsperoPackageBuilder.SignPackage(System.String,LibProsperoPkg.ProsperoBuildOptions,System.Action{System.String},System.Collections.Generic.List{System.String})
member.summary: Produces a detached PKG-metadata signature for the finished package using the embedded PKG-metadata RSA-3072 key (and consumes the content id + passcode to derive the package EKPFS). The signature is RSA-3072 PKCS#1 v1.5 over the SHA-256 of the container's metadata region (header + entry table) and is written next to the package as <pkg>.metasig.
member.remarks: The detached signature and the checked key material are self-validated; a fully accepted retail image additionally requires console-controlled secrets.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.Util.Crypto.RsaPkcs1EncryptKey(System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Encrypts with an RSA public key — big-endian , public exponent 65537 — using EME-PKCS#1 v1.5 (type 2) padding. This is the PS5 CNT key-entry wrapping: the ciphertext length equals the modulus length (384 bytes = RSA-3072). The PKCS#1 pad is random, so successive calls are not byte-identical, but each decrypts to under the corresponding private key.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.Util.Crypto.ComputeKeys(System.String,System.String,System.UInt32)
member.summary: Computes keys for the package. The key is the result of a SHA256 hash of the concatenation of: - The SHA256 hash of the index (4 bytes big-endian) - The SHA256 hash of the Content ID (36 bytes padded to 48 with nulls) - The passcode The EKPFS is Index 1.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.Util.Crypto.ComputeKeys(System.String,System.String,System.UInt32,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Computes keys for the package, selecting the per-generation digest primitive. EKPFS (Index 1) = H( H(Index, 4 bytes big-endian) || H(ContentId padded to 48 with nulls) || Passcode ), where H = SHA3-256 (useSha3: true) or SHA-256 (useSha3: false). The SHA3 form yields the EKPFS used for the outer PFS image; combine it with / using newCrypt: true.
